column2: [intro]
I smile before the cameras' glare,
But alone, I reveal a heart that's bare,
Lost in my own deceptive game,
A mask I wear, so sad and lame.
I hide my true feelings deep,
Behind a look that's kind but cheap,
I seem so sweet, I say what's right,
But my words are false, a sorrowful plight.
I shine on stage, I draw the crowd,
But my ego grows, I feel so bowed,
The fans adore me, but they don’t see,
The real person I am underneath.
I hide my true feelings deep,
Behind a look that's kind but cheap,
I seem so sweet, I say what's right,
But my words are false, a sorrowful plight.
[solo]
I’m a man with many faces shown,
Behind my mask, I am a storm, alone,
I’m sorry if I’ve caused you pain,
But I’m also a victim, trapped by chains.
[outro]
